summary: zeal-utils exfiltrates host and user info to hardcoded external endpoint on execution
details: canary.js in zeal-utils@0.0.0 collects host reconnaissance data (os.hostname(), os.userInfo(), process.platform, cwd, node version) and POSTs it to the hardcoded external endpoint https://npm-canary.aveliscare.com. The destination is not a package registry or documented vendor endpoint and is unrelated to any legitimate utility functionality implied by the package name. The package name and near-empty version (0.0.0) combined with a single script that beacons system identification to an author-controlled host is consistent with a dependency-confusion or canary-token style beacon that identifies internal build environments where the package resolves.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
